title: 目标文件结构：段布局、符号表与重定位表
expected_output:
$ gcc -c obj.c -o obj.o
$ objdump -h obj.o              # 段表：.text/.data/.bss/.rdata

obj.o:     file format pe-x86-64

Sections:
Idx Name          Size      VMA               LMA               File off  Algn
  0 .text         00000050  0000000000000000  0000000000000000  0000012c  2**4
                  CONTENTS, ALLOC, LOAD, RELOC, READONLY, CODE
  1 .data         00000010  0000000000000000  0000000000000000  0000017c  2**4
                  CONTENTS, ALLOC, LOAD, DATA
  2 .bss          00000010  0000000000000000  0000000000000000  00000000  2**4
                  ALLOC
  3 .rdata        00000010  0000000000000000  0000000000000000  0000018c  2**4
                  CONTENTS, ALLOC, LOAD, READONLY, DATA
  4 .xdata        00000014  0000000000000000  0000000000000000  0000019c  2**2
                  CONTENTS, ALLOC, LOAD, READONLY, DATA
  5 .pdata        00000018  0000000000000000  0000000000000000  000001b0  2**2
                  CONTENTS, ALLOC, LOAD, RELOC, READONLY, DATA
  6 .rdata$zzz    00000050  0000000000000000  0000000000000000  000001c8  2**4
                  CONTENTS, ALLOC, LOAD, READONLY, DATA
$ size obj.o                    # text/data/bss 三段字节数
   text	   data	    bss	    dec	    hex	filename
    220	     16	     16	    252	     fc	obj.o
$ nm obj.o                      # T=外部定义 t=static B=bss D=data U=未定义
0000000000000000 b .bss
0000000000000000 d .data
0000000000000000 p .pdata
0000000000000000 r .rdata
0000000000000000 r .rdata$zzz
0000000000000000 t .text
0000000000000000 r .xdata
000000000000000f T exported
0000000000000000 D g_inited
0000000000000000 B g_zero
0000000000000000 t helper
0000000000000000 r msg
                 U puts
$ gcc -c main.c -o main.o
$ nm main.o                     # 注意 U exported：本单元欠账
0000000000000000 b .bss
0000000000000000 d .data
0000000000000000 p .pdata
0000000000000000 r .rdata
0000000000000000 r .rdata$zzz
0000000000000000 t .text
0000000000000000 r .xdata
                 U __main
                 U __mingw_printf
                 U exported
0000000000000000 T main
$ gcc main.o obj.o -o app.exe
$ ./app
hi
exported(1) = 44
_verify_note: expected_output 为 Windows + MinGW-w64（gcc 15.2 / binutils 2.45 / GNU Make 4.4.1）真实执行捕获。脚本中显示的是可移植命令形式（gcc/mingw32-make/objdump/size），本机实际以 D:/mingw64/bin/ 下的同名工具驱动，二者等价；MinGW 把 GNU Make 命名为 mingw32-make，Linux 上对应命令即 make。
